ff.ui.024: Dogfight view. Drag anywhere on the screen to steer
ff.ui.030: Promotional image for Fight Flight: 2 Zero-style aircraft exchanging fire above the clouds
ff.ui.031: Take to the skies in a Zero. Enjoy aerial combat through flying and shooting.
ff.ui.032: Take to the skies in a Zero. Enjoy flying and shooting in Normal or Easy mode.
ff.ui.034: 300 seconds. Automatic fire; reloads in 6 seconds after running out of ammunition. The only action button is Loop.
ff.ui.042: Default keyboard controls: arrow keys to steer, L to loop. In Normal mode, Space fires, W accelerates and S slows down. Change keys in Control settings; see current bindings in Rules and controls.
ff.ui.045: Normal uses Fire, Loop and the throttle lever. Push up to accelerate, down to slow; release to center the lever and maintain the adjusted speed. Easy fires automatically and only uses the Loop button. Shooting down 1 aircraft earns 1,000 points. Fewer shots earn more ammo-saving points; a completed loop earns 150 points. More aircraft damage means a larger deduction from the final score.
ff.ui.049: Refresh your browser and try again.
ff.ui.059: Radar range matches visibility: 1.5km. On-screen enemies are filled markers; off-screen enemies are hollow. Beyond-range enemies are shown by triangles on the edge.
ff.ui.061: Up accelerates, down slows. Release to center the lever and hold the adjusted speed. When focused, use arrow keys to adjust.
ff.ui.062: Wingspan about 12m, length about 9.06m. Equipped with 2 7.7mm machine guns and 2 20mm cannons. Fire shoots both; if one runs out, the other remains usable. When both run out, your aircraft reloads for 6 seconds. The aiming ring and countdown show progress. Enemies repeat attack-and-disengage runs like Kaisen, with unlimited ammunition.
ff.ui.068: You can play without a name. Unnamed plays are unranked; only the play count is recorded. To enter the leaderboard, enter a name of up to 20 characters before takeoff. Rankings are separate by mode.
ff.ui.069: Entering a name publishes your name and record on the leaderboard. You can leave it blank (up to 20 characters). Unnamed plays are unranked and only count toward plays.
ff.ui.070: Steering during a loop cancels it, returns the aircraft toward level and lets you keep steering. Both modes assist turning until an enemy appears on screen.
ff.ui.074: Score = shootdown points + ammo-saving points + loop points − damage penalty (minimum 0). Enemies downed by collision count as regular shootdowns.
ff.ui.079: Earn points for shootdowns, saving ammo and loops
ff.ui.084: Master flying and shooting, and race across the sky.
ff.ui.086: Colliding with an enemy downs both aircraft and ends your flight immediately. The enemy counts as a regular shootdown, with no collision-specific bonus.
ff.ui.087: Turning loses speed, climbing slows you down and diving speeds you up. Flight and control calculations are simplified for smartphones. Radar is a gameplay aid.
ff.ui.099: Drag anywhere in the sky to steer. Firing is automatic. Loop with the on-screen button or L key.
ff.ui.102: National Naval Aviation Museum: A6M2 Zero
ff.ui.103: National Museum of the U.S. Air Force: Mitsubishi A6M2 Zero
ff.ui.108: The throttle lever overlaps other controls. Rotate the screen or adjust its position and size in Control settings.
ff.ui.113: Aerial combat based on the Zero Model Twenty-One. Normal has unlimited time and manual fire; Easy has 300 seconds and automatic fire. Both modes reload in 6 seconds after using all 288 7.7mm rounds and 96 20mm rounds. Drag anywhere in the sky to steer.
ff.ui.120: At or below 1,200m, a low-altitude warning starts. Flight ends 10 seconds later. Climbing does not clear the warning. The countdown stops while paused.
ff.ui.132: Esc cancels input; Tab moves focus. Ctrl, Alt or ⌘ combinations and browser-reserved keys cannot be assigned.

ff.ui.141: Choose an action and press 1 key. Left/right Shift and numpad keys are distinct. Applies to both modes.
ff.ui.143: Choose a control and adjust the sliders. You can also drag it in the preview below.

ff.ui.201: Drag anywhere in the sky to steer. Use buttons to fire and loop. Throttle up accelerates, down slows; release to hold speed.
ff.ui.202: Unlimited time. Manual fire; reloads in 6 seconds after running out of ammunition.
ff.ui.203: Steer with the keyboard or by dragging the mouse. Firing is automatic. Watch the tracers and aim a little ahead.
ff.ui.204: Drag anywhere in the sky to steer. Firing is automatic. Watch the tracers and aim ahead; loop with the on-screen button.

ff.ui.261: Radar. Forward is up; visibility 1.5km, marks every 500m. {{arg1}} enemies. Filled markers are on screen, hollow markers off screen, edge triangles out of range. Up/down marks show altitude difference.
ff.ui.263: Fly and shoot down enemies to earn points. Defeating all enemies does not end the game: more aircraft arrive.
ff.ui.264: Easy has 300 seconds of active flight time. The countdown stops while paused.
ff.ui.265: Normal has no time limit. Elapsed time is displayed.
ff.ui.267: Flight ends when your HP reaches 0, you collide with an enemy, or 10 seconds pass after a low-altitude warning. Easy also ends after 300 seconds.
ff.ui.268: A low-altitude warning starts at or below 1200m. Once started, climbing does not clear it.
ff.ui.269: Pausing stops your aircraft, enemies, bullets, reloading and time limits. Closing instructions or settings does not automatically resume flight.
ff.ui.272: Touch an area of sky without buttons and drag from there to steer. Releasing resets steering input. You can press buttons with another finger.
ff.ui.273: Easy fires automatically at enemies inside the aiming circle and within 1.2km. Watch the tracers and aim a little ahead. The action button is Loop.
ff.ui.274: In Normal, hold Fire to shoot. Push the throttle up to accelerate or down to slow. Release to center it and maintain speed. Press Loop again for each loop. Bullets have no aim assist.
ff.ui.275: Change button position, size and opacity in Control settings. You can also switch to keyboard settings.
ff.ui.276: Easy fires automatically at enemies inside the aiming circle and within 1.2km. Watch the tracers and aim a little ahead.
ff.ui.277: Normal fires only while the fire key is held. Hold acceleration and deceleration keys too. Bullets have no aim assist.
ff.ui.278: You can also steer by dragging the sky with the mouse. Change each key in Control settings. Press the loop key again for each loop.
ff.ui.280: After using all 288 machine-gun rounds and 96 cannon rounds, reloading takes 6 seconds. 1 cannon round delivers more damage per shot; both weapons lose damage over distance.
ff.ui.281: Enemies normally arrive every 14 seconds, with up to 5 alive. After the last enemy is downed, a replacement arrives in 3 seconds.
ff.ui.282: Shootdowns, ammo savings and completed loops earn points; actual damage to your aircraft deducts points. Collision shootdowns count as 1 regular aircraft.
ff.ui.284: Names are optional. Flights started with a name are eligible for the mode-specific score leaderboard.
ff.ui.285: Unnamed plays are unranked and only the play count is recorded. Results show the top 30 for the same mode.
ff.ui.286: You can play without a connection. Check submission status and use the displayed retry option.
ff.ui.300: Some play records cannot be read. The original records are preserved, and processing continues for the other records.
